notes.title: Patch 1.4.8 Notes
notes.content:
We’ve fixed an issue that would cause players to be stuck in Copper Creek after speaking with Evelyn while getting your climbing gear. This prevented you from moving onward toward Camber Cape or interacting with other items. This patch fixes that issue: load your save file and restart your conversation with Evelyn to continue. 

Thanks for the feedback and helping us fix the issue!

Now, grab your climbing gear and head back. If you loved the game, give OXENFREE II a five star Steam review and tell us what you liked.  If you run into any other issues, give us a shout at our [url=https://nightschoolstudio.com/support]customer support portal[/url].

notes.title: Patch 1.4 Notes
notes.content:
Welcome back to Camena. OXENFREE II's 1.4 patch is now live and thanks to your feedback and help, we fixed a few things in this version of the game:  
[list]
[*] Improved Jacob's walking, traversal, and conversation. 
[*] More stable walkie talkie conversations.
[*] Resolved crashing or blockers at the Community Center, Garland, General Store, Funnie's Family Market, Copper Creek Trail, Berenson Creek, caves, mines, and end game content.
[*] So many more minor fixes that we can’t list them all!
[/list]
Loop back and if your return trip is smooth, leave us a five star Steam review and tell us what you liked.  If you run into any other issues, give us a shout at our [url=https://nightschoolstudio.com/support]customer support portal[/url]. You can do this, Ryebread -- you’re more capable than you think.

notes.title: Patch 1.3 Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315789/de809b828608bdebd5ddbf21d3e8eb2f380c0531.jpg[/img]

Thank you so much for playing OXENFREE II during our launch week! Your reviews, social media posts, and reactions to the game have been overwhelming and amazing. Camena’s been overrun with disruptions in the electromagnetic spectrum but you've made it a cozier place to be.

We just updated the game with a patch to fix a few things including:
[list]
[*] Improved click and drag for mouse controls.
[*] Made changes to the Community Center scene to fix freezing/crashing, audio distortion, muted music or other instabilities.
[*] Improved animation and traversal.
[*] Fixed general auto-save and save file issues.
[/list]

We're working to address other issues in an upcoming patch. If you encounter something strange – other than ghosts – visit our [url=https://nightschoolstudio.com/support]customer support portal[/url] for extra help. Also, if you love the game so far, help us out by leaving a review or giving us a shout on [url=https://twitter.com/nightschoolers]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@nightschoolstudio]TikTok[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/nightschoolstudio/]Instagram[/url], or [url=https://facebook.com/nightschoolstudio]Facebook[/url].
